# A12 — Expo/RN build repos cannot use upstream's EAS-based CI

**Section**: A. Build pipeline
**Keywords**: android, assemble, build, cannot, eas, eas-based, expo, expo_token, github-actions, gradle, local, needs, no-install, ownership, pipeline, plain, platform, prebuild, project, repos, rn, upstream

## Problem

Expo/RN build repos cannot use upstream's EAS-based CI

## Root cause

eas build --local needs EAS project ownership + EXPO_TOKEN

## Solution

expo prebuild --platform android --no-install + plain gradle assemble
